# The shapes stairs take from the stairs beside them, as both official servers' shape updates decide it (harness 0.14.0
# stairs report; 1.21.8 and 1.21.4 identical). Per line: the facing and half of oak stairs, the kind of their
# neighbors, and 6561 shape codes (0 straight, 1 inner_left, 2 inner_right, 3 outer_left, 4 outer_right), the north
# neighbor varying fastest, then east, south and west: 0 air, 1 + 2 * facing + half (facings north, east, south,
# west; halves bottom, top).

north	top	oak_stairs	
east	bottom	oak_stairs	
east	top	oak_stairs	
south	bottom	oak_stairs	
south	top	oak_stairs	
west	bottom	oak_stairs	
west	top	oak_stairs

north	top	cobblestone_stairs	
east	bottom	cobblestone_stairs	
east	top	cobblestone_stairs

south	top	cobblestone_stairs
